hebrewText: וּ/בִ/שְׁנַ֨ת שְׁמוֹנֶ֤ה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ לְ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ לְ/טַהֵ֥ר הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/הַ/בָּ֑יִת שָׁ֠לַח אֶת שָׁפָ֨ן בֶּן אֲצַלְיָ֜הוּ וְ/אֶת מַעֲשֵׂיָ֣הוּ שַׂר הָ/עִ֗יר וְ֠/אֵת יוֹאָ֤ח בֶּן יֽוֹאָחָז֙ הַ/מַּזְכִּ֔יר לְ/חַזֵּ֕ק אֶת בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי/ו

tokens.bdb: a year (as a revolution of time)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] whole age, [idiom] long, [phrase] old, year([idiom] -ly).

tokens.bdb: a cardinal number, eight (as if a surplus above the 'perfect' seven); also (as ordinal) eighth
tokens.kjv: eight(-een, -eenth), eighth.

tokens.bdb: ten (only in combination), i.e. -teen; also (ordinal) -teenth
tokens.kjv: (eigh-, fif-, four-, nine-, seven-, six-, thir-) teen(-th), [phrase] eleven(-th), [phrase] sixscore thousand, [phrase] twelve(-th).

tokens.bdb: to reign; inceptively, to ascend the throne; causatively, to induct into royalty; hence (by implication) to take counsel
tokens.kjv: consult, [idiom] indeed, be (make, set a, set up) king, be (make) queen, (begin to, make to) reign(-ing), rule, [idiom] surely.

tokens.bdb: to be pure (physical sound, clear, unadulterated; Levitically, uncontaminated; morally, innocent or holy)
tokens.kjv: be (make, make self, pronounce) clean, cleanse (self), purge, purify(-ier, self).

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.

tokens.bdb: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
tokens.kjv: court, daughter, door, [phrase] dungeon, family, [phrase] forth of, [idiom] great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, [phrase] prison, [phrase] steward, [phrase] tablet, temple, web, [phrase] within(-out).

tokens.explanationEn: a house (in the greatest variation of applications

tokens.bdb: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, [idiom] earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out).

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
